title: Lessons learned from another rural soul
en: there's something special about a snowy day when the world turns varying shades of blue gray and white with hints of color dappled among the pines the snow i find is a gentle entity hushing sounds and creating a space that feels celestial luke and i love to spend time by the river and in the winter it's particularly stunning the ripples of snow covering the rocky banks contrasted with the icy darkness of the water there's something innately calming about the view

i first met luke two summers ago when i had first moved here as someone who is happily single i wasn't too keen on the idea to put it mildly it's very liberating to be your own best friend because relationships are no longer a desperate necessity instead they are a rich compliment to your pre-existing happiness my relationship is a way of grounding me a gentle reminder that cultivating friendships no matter what form they take can challenge you in the best way

and make you a better person because of it interactions aren't always easy love is a feeling but also at times a choice and the same goes for living i don't always feel happy because feelings come and go but there's nothing i can do about that i can choose to be simply content and for me that's led to a deeper fulfillment that is unshaken by more fleeting emotions our mutual commitment has made us able

to enjoy the good times and occasional struggles with grace it also helps that we have very similar energy and do not feel pressure to constantly do new things instead we simply enjoy each other's company as we go about our daily tasks as you can see luke is also an artist and i invited him over so that he could share a bit of his process with you while i worked on some salto ornaments that i'm making for my students to paint art comes in many forms complex and simple and each has its own worth i encourage you to find a creative outlet whatever it may be even if your projects don't turn out

exactly how you wish don't let yourself judge it too harshly when we compare our own creations with those of another we devalue the story of the item we made it may not be perfect but it is our own i think that goes for living as well our imperfections our stylistic details and our personal decisions creative license living is an art make it your own and don't compare your story with that of another she's

as two creative spirits we have connected over our shared love of beautiful things luke enjoys to hike up mountains searching for crystals and his interest in gemstones led him to begin wire weaving which is an art form i had never heard about until i met him but it is absolutely stunning he is a wonderful example of what patience and practice can achieve and how creativity blossoms when you let go of your self-consciousness
i admire him greatly for that and take his example every day you
zh: 下雪天有一种特别的感觉，世界变成了深浅不一的蓝灰色和白色，松树间斑驳的色彩斑驳，我发现雪是一个温柔的实体，安静的声音，创造出一个感觉像天上卢克的空间，我喜欢在河边度过时光，冬天，覆盖在岩石岸上的雪的涟漪尤其令人惊叹，与冰冷的黑暗水形成鲜明对比，景色有一种天生的平静。
我第一次见到卢克是在两年前的夏天，当时我刚搬到这里，作为一个单身快乐的人，我不太热衷于这个想法，温和地说，成为自己最好的朋友是非常自由的，因为人际关系不再是迫切需要的，而是对你先前存在的幸福的丰富赞美。我的关系是一种让我扎根的方式，温柔地提醒我，培养友谊，无论采取什么形式，都可以以最好的方式挑战你。
让你成为一个更好的人，因为互动并不总是那么容易，爱是一种感觉，但有时也是一种选择，生活也是如此，我并不总是感到快乐，因为感觉来来去去，但我无能为力，我只能选择简单的满足，对我来说，这会带来更深刻的满足，不会被更多转瞬即逝的情感所动摇，我们的共同承诺使我们能够
为了享受美好时光和偶尔的优雅挣扎，我们拥有非常相似的能量，不会感到不断做新事物的压力，相反，我们只是在处理日常任务时享受彼此的陪伴，因为你可以看到卢克也是一位艺术家，我邀请他过来，以便他可以与你分享一些他的过程，而我正在为我的学生制作一些萨尔托装饰品，绘画艺术有多种形式，复杂和简单，每种都有自己的价值，我鼓励你找到一个创造性的出口，无论它是什么即使你的项目没有成功也可能
正是你所希望的，不要让自己太严厉地评判，当我们将自己的创作与他人的作品进行比较时，我们会贬低我们制作的物品的故事，它可能并不完美，但它是我们自己的，我认为这也适用于生活，我们的不完美，我们的风格细节和我们的个人决定，创造性的许可，生活是一门艺术，让它成为你自己的，不要将你的故事与别人的故事进行比较。
作为两个富有创造力的人，我们因对美丽事物的共同热爱而联系在一起，卢克喜欢爬山寻找水晶，他对宝石的兴趣促使他开始编织金属丝，这是一种艺术形式，在我遇见他之前我从未听说过这种艺术形式，但这绝对令人惊叹，他是一个很好的例子，说明耐心和实践可以实现什么，以及当你放弃自我意识时创造力如何绽放
我因此非常钦佩他，并且每天都以他为榜样
